Gray (Giant [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliidan]] variety) |haircolor=None |feathers= |eyecolor=Black |distinctions=[[Vacuumbreather|Live in vacuum of space]], long wings, limbless''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' |lifespan= |origin=*[[Kaliida Nebula]]{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} *[[Rishi moon]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}} *[[Rugosa]]{{DB|location|rugosa|Rugosa}} *[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] |habitat= |diet= |language= }} {{Quote|That one looks hungry!''"
"''Nah, he's just smiling at you.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], dodging neebray in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]|}} '''Neebray''' were flying, limbless creatures which varied greatly in size and habitat. They could be found on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], such as [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Rishi moon|moon]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] (where they sometimes circled over [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]), and even in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], notably in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] along the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:Neebray_manta.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Giant neebray mantas in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]]] On the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], tiny baby neebray flew among the coral forests of the moon's long-dried-up ocean beds as a stop along their [[Balmorra Run/Legends|interstellar voyage]]. A moderately large variety had translucent wings, and could be found on a [[Rishi moon]]. The gigantic neebray manta lived in the vacuum of space, feeding on stellar gases. They used the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] as nesting grounds. They also used [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]] as feeding ground,[[The Clone Wars 12|''The Clone Wars'' 12]] feeding on its stellar gases.''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' ==History== During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] encountered a flock of neebray mantas while navigating the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]] on their way through the Kaliida Nebula. A brush with one caused one of [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick's]] engine stabilizers to give out. This crippling would cause Matchstick and [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag's]] deaths during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]]. A brush with another neebray caused another pilot's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid's]] dome to be knocked off, destroying it. [[Tofen Vane]] and [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|his raiders]] hid [[Harko Station|their base]] in the [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]]. When the Republic attacked the base, Vane and his raiders used a transmission to make the neebray attack the Republic ships. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Rishi_moon_neebray.png|thumb|right|180px|A neebray on Rishi moon]] At least three separate neebray breeds were based on the neebray manta model, and do not necessarily all have to be neebray manta. Similar creatures included the [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] and [[Oswaft]]. [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] mispronounced the name as "NEH-bray man-ta" in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]." ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} *{{TCW|Ambush}} *{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}} {{Mo}} *{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} *[[The Clone Wars 12|''The Clone Wars'' 12]] *[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']] {{Ab|Kenobi (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of neebray}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stm}} *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' *[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]] *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' *{{DB|location|rugosa|Rugosa}} {{1stID|Neebray}} *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' *{{SWE|locations|rugosa|Rugosa}} *''[[Fly Casual]]'' {{C|as Neebray manta}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Neebray |de=Neebray-Manta |es=Neebray/Leyendas |it=Neebray |pl=Neebray }} [[Category:Creatures of Tatooine]] [[Category:Creatures of unspecified diet]] [[Category:Flying creatures]] [[Category:Non-sentient species]] [[Category:Space-borne creatures]] [[Category:Vertebrates]]
